verdict.rationale: Gecko's v1 API explicitly lists managing scan schedules, so recurring security scans can be set up. However, that is the only evidence: a single mention, and scheduling appears limited to scans rather than arbitrary workflows. Webhooks react to events but do not provide scheduling. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron/frequency options, UI support), scheduling of workflows beyond scans, hands-on or independent corroboration.
